name: Stanislaw
source:
This is the man who'd said that no matter how hellish the City became, it wouldn't change the fact that money was the magical tool for obtaining everything. 
Fixer Stanislaw, the black market dealer, it was of no personal concern to him who lived and who died. By the standards of ten years ago, Fixer Stanislaw would never be considered a good person, it simply wouldn't be possible.
(Edited from in-game text)
